real_qa.q: Why should a real estate attorney order a title report before the contract is signed when buying a house in New York?
real_qa.r: Getting the title report right away allows you to identify any open permits on the property that the seller must close out or may not even be aware of. This proactive approach helps streamline the entire process, and you can give the seller advance notice of issues like old permits from decades past that need closure before final closing.
